title: Descent of finitely presented modules and of maps between fixed models
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Fix i\in I, let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], put X=X_i\times_{S_i}S and X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j for j\ge i [def-pc-base-change]; for a module F_j on X_j and j'\ge j write (F_j)_{j'} and (F_j)_X for its pullbacks to X_{j'} and X. Then: (1) (modules) for every finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_X-module M [pqf-def-coherent] there are j\ge i, a finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-module M_j and an isomorphism (M_j)_X\cong M; (2) (morphisms) given j\ge i, finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules F_j,G_j and an \mathcal{O}_X-linear map \varphi:(F_j)_X\to(G_j)_X, there are j'\ge j and an \mathcal{O}_{X_{j'}}-linear map \varphi_{j'}:(F_j)_{j'}\to(G_j)_{j'} whose pullback to X is \varphi (through the canonical isomorphisms ((F_j)_{j'})_X\cong(F_j)_X, ((G_j)_{j'})_X\cong(G_j)_X).
